verdict.rationale: Nix's own CLI documents creating and building flakes and installing software over URLs, which are first-party ways to add package sources beyond the main package set. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents overlays, plugins, third-party repositories or pluggable backends. missing for 10: explicit documentation of overlays or third-party flake inputs, plugin or backend extension APIs, examples of consuming third-party package sources, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extend the manager through third-party taps, overlays, plugins, or backends

citations.quote: Create a new flake: # nix flake new hello ... Build the flake in the current directory: # nix build
Easy installation of software over URLs.
